no_tariff: No tariff: the limits are set for you directly.
limit_networks: Simultaneous VLESS connections per device on each server
reset_monthly_anchor: per month from the start day
exhausted_throttle: the speed drops until the reset
devices_hint: Each device receives its own AmneziaWG and VLESS configurations.
devices_empty: No devices yet. Add one to get a configuration.
rotate_xray_warning: The device's current VLESS access is revoked on every server and new access is issued instead. Old VLESS links stop working: get the configuration again. AmneziaWG does not change.
rotate_awg_warning: The device's current AmneziaWG access is revoked on every server and new access is issued on each instead. Old AmneziaWG configurations stop working once the servers apply the change: get the configuration again. VLESS does not change.
delete_warning: This device’s AmneziaWG and VLESS configurations will stop working.
networks: VLESS connections now: {active} of {limit} on the busiest server
connect_hint: Choose a server and a protocol; the configuration opens under its row.
configs_closed: Configurations are not issued while access is paused.
config_failed: The configuration could not be made now. Try again later.
qr_too_long: The configuration is too long for a QR code: use the file or the link.
import_xray: Import the VLESS file or link into your client, or scan the QR code.
import_awg: Import the .vpn file in AmneziaVPN or scan the QR code; the .conf file goes to a compatible AmneziaWG client.
subscription_lead: One link to every server you can use: the client keeps the list up to date and picks a fast one.
subscription_later: The subscription will appear here later; for now, choose a server yourself.
